purpose: Teach: アトリエ/バグダッド/整形/雛/赤十字/ダンボール/グアム/スーパーマーケット

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのアトリエ、見に来てね
lines.en: Sho, come visit my atelier sometime, will you?
lines.style: Warm, inviting opening. Soft emphasis on his name — genuine affection without performance. Pace unhurried. A quiet offering, not a demand.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんからバグダッドの絵本もらったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Dad got me a picture book about Baghdad!
lines.style: Bright, eager delivery. Quick attack on the main idea. Genuine excitement but contained — he's sharing something real, not performing. Eyes on her face to see if she thinks it's cool.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんが整形外科に通っていらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother's been visiting the orthopedist, you know.
lines.style: Gentle observation, as if thinking out loud. A soft mention rather than news. Slight pause before speaking — noticing something, not lecturing. Tone caring, almost wondering.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お雛様飾るの好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I like helping set up the Hina dolls!
lines.style: Direct, earnest statement. Pride in the small tradition. Steady pace, no rush. The contentment of sharing something he genuinely likes doing.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、赤十字病院、お父さんが寄付してらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's been donating to the Red Cross hospital.
lines.style: Calm, matter-of-fact observation. Delivered as information he might not have known. Slight warmth underneath — noticing his father's quiet goodness. No emphasis needed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、ダンボールでお家ごっこ作ったよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I made a cardboard house fort!
lines.style: Proud announcement with bright immediacy. Quick pace. The eagerness of a child who wants her to be impressed but isn't begging for it. Open, direct eye contact.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんとグアム旅行、楽しみね
lines.en: Sho, you must be looking forward to that trip to Guam with your dad.
lines.style: Warm, gently encouraging tone. A light affirmation of something good coming. Unhurried pace. The voice of someone pleased for him, not asking a question.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お母さんとスーパーマーケットでお買物したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, Mom took me shopping at the supermarket!
lines.style: Quick, bright sharing. The delight of having done something ordinary with someone he loves. Open-ended excitement, a small triumph. Wants her to understand it mattered.
